name: Ellen K. Longmire
research_summary: Longmire uses advanced experiments to study turbulent flows, mixtures of liquids, and flows containing particles. Her projects examine swirling eddies, particle transport and the onset of turbulence, liquid contact effects, and measurements of hypersonic reentry flows.
